text:
mike: Heads-up — putting a proposal on the table for a new "Flex Pack" add-on (burst credits + soft-cap gating) for Dedicated customers. Want quick alignment on launch criteria and contractual guardrails.

tara: curious — is this aimed at net-new signups or existing reserve customers who need burst?

mike: both, but priority is existing Reserved customers hitting unpredictable weekly spikes. Sales asked for a way to avoid emergency overage negotiations.

jeff: from sales POV we need: 1) clear SKU + price, 2) definable soft-cap threshold per contract, 3) override workflow for AEs.

ana: finance: also need rules for revenue treatment — prepaid credits vs post-pay usage. Prefers prepaid credits (easier to recognize) but that affects UX.

ana: also flag: if we do a 14-day grace window we need to model expected churn impact.

mike: initial product sketch — SKU would be time-boxed burst credits sold monthly. Policy options: soft cap (warn) -> soft cap + throttle window -> hard cap.

lina: engineering question — do we have the routing/tracing to charge per-route burst consumption? we need per-token attribution to a contract id.

jeff: sales-bot: can we get an example clause for contracts? :point_down:
sales-bot: "Flex Pack: Customer may purchase monthly burst credits (Flex Units). Usage beyond Reserved capacity consumes Flex Units. Soft-cap behavior: around-specified threshold customer receives warning; operator may throttle or bill overage per contract. Flex Units expire at period end."

mike: proposing launch criteria: (a) billing integration that supports prepaid Flex Units, (b) UI in Console to buy/allocate Flex Units, (c) telemetry + alerting for soft-cap thresholds, (d) 3 pilot customers signed.

jeff: timeline ask — can we do a beta in 8 weeks if eng prioritizes? Sales says pilots ready.

lina: rough eng effort — building per-contract credit ledger + Console UI + alerting. Estimate 6-10 sprint-weeks with one backend engineer + one frontend + small infra work. Need product spec and acceptance tests.

mike: minimal API/sku shape suggestion (for engineering):
```
{
  "sku": "flex-pack-monthly",
  "units": 1000000,
  "unit_type": "token",
  "expiry": "monthly",
  "soft_cap_pct": 90,
  "grace_window_days": 14
}
```

tara: sounds reasonable. We should also include an override flag for enterprise deals: `allow_manual_override: true|false`.

ana: finance — ok to proceed if we treat as prepaid credits by default, and allow post-pay only with credit checks. Need a clear migration path in docs.

jeff: legal will want explicit language on throttling and fallbacks. Can we include automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when hard cap hit? product: yes but that needs engineered routing rules.

lina: can implement fallback to lower-cost model family, but we need per-request routing policy config and budget tracking. Adds ~2 sprints.

mike: decision points for this thread: (1) default accounting model = prepaid credits (ana ok), (2) grace window = 14 days (proposed), (3) allow enterprise manual overrides (yes, gated), (4) include automatic model fallback as optional toggle.

tara: action items: mike to draft product PRD with acceptance criteria, lina to submit rough eng estimate + dependency list, ana to coordinate finance/recognition notes, jeff to line up pilot customers and legal.

mike: timeline: aim for internal beta sign-off in 8w, public GA in 14w assuming pilot outcomes.

jeff: +1. I'll book pilot kickoff meetings this week.

lina: I'll post a short tech spec draft in #eng-platform by EOD Monday.

ana: I'll model 3 pricing options (conservative, mid, aggressive) and share numbers by Thursday.

mike: thanks — tagging @tara and @jeff for final confirmation later today. :rocket:

tara: ack, will review PRD draft and add sales acceptance criteria. :+1:
